proposals.title: Initiate Meaningful Shareholder Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so a single stockholder seeking written consent can request a record date, rather than holders of 25% of shares.
proposals.evidence: The Company recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: EEO-1 Disclosure
proposals.proponent: The Congregation of Benedictine Sisters, Boerne, Texas
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a diversity report with employee gender and race data by EEOC job category, affirmative action summary, and diversity programs description, available by September 2020.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Executive Ownership Guidelines
proposals.proponent: The Lynne M Gerber Traditional Beneficial IRA of Judith S Gerber, together with other co-filers, represented by As You Sow
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to require senior executives to retain a significant percentage of equity-acquired shares for a significant period after employment ends.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Electioneering Contributions Congruency Analysis
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures are congruent with publicly stated company values and policies, including brand risk analysis.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.
